claim: The daily email's position-movers block was noise: at 1-2 impressions the MEDIAN query moves 4 spots doing nothing. The impression FLOOR did all the work; raising the spot threshold alone made it worse.

body.decision: DEC-327 / DAL-268 (2026-08-27). The consequence ticket after DAL-261 fixed the truncation.
body.finding: The daily email's 'position movers' block was noise, and the truncation fix made that visible rather than causing it. Old rule: moved 5+ spots, NO impression floor, sorted by size of move, top 10. ~316 qualifying rows/week, 45% of them queries that vanished from GSC entirely the next week, 31% held. Of the rows actually PRINTED the median had 1 impression and 98% had <=2 in both weeks.
body.why_structural: Sorting by size of move selects the extreme tail, and the extreme tail of a position distribution is wherever the data is thinnest. The block was guaranteed to print the least reliable rows available.
body.noise_floor_measured: Median absolute week-over-week position swing by min impressions across both weeks, 8 windows 2026-06-30..2026-08-24: 1-2 impr n=4192 median 4.0 p90 26.0 and 45% move >=5; 3-9 n=1186 median 2.2 p90 12.9; 10-29 n=231 median 1.4 p90 8.7; 30+ n=15 median 0.5. At 1-2 impressions the MEDIAN query moves 4 spots doing nothing.
body.the_broken_dial_was_the_floor_not_the_sp: Backtested on whether the move was still there a week later. No floor + 15 spots = 131 rows/wk, 50% vanished, 27% held (WORSE than the old rule). Floor 5 + 5 spots = 27 rows/wk, 2% vanished, 54% held. Floor 5 + 10 spots = 10 rows/wk, 2% vanished, 51% held. Raising the spot threshold alone made it worse; the floor did all the work.
body.shipped: MOVER_MIN_IMPRESSIONS = 5 (in BOTH weeks), MOVER_MIN_SPOTS = 10 (one clear of the 10-29 band p90 of 8.7), NEW_QUERY_MIN_IMPRESSIONS = 5, and movers sorted by impressions not by change. tools/autonomous/traffic_report.py, deployed.
body.new_query_threshold: At >=3 impressions: 123 rows/wk, 52% gone the following week, 4% ever earned a click. At >=5: 23 rows/wk, 76% persist, 10% earned a click.
body.live_output_verified: Same evening: buy olive tree 37->21, olive trees for sale near me 34->20, lime trees for sale 7->20, plum trees for sale 12->23, macadamia trees for sale 60->23. Commercial intent, 10-22 impressions each. Independently surfaced the same olive and macadamia stories the page-level pass found.
body.guard: tests/test_traffic_report_query_movement.py, 9 tests. Proven to FAIL before trusted to pass (DEC-326): reverted to the old rule and 4 of 9 fail. Full suite 3,555 OK.
